# After Docs Freeze

Comment on each tracked KEP whose docs PR is not marked `Complete (Merged PR)`
on the Release Tracking Board after Docs Freeze.

```text
Hello KEP and docs owners! <future release> Docs team here.

This PR did not meet the [Docs Freeze](https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/blob/master/releases/release_phases.md#docs-freeze) deadline.
Enhancements without the required documentation may be removed from the current release. If you still wish to include this enhancement in <future release>, please file an [exception request](https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/blob/master/releases/EXCEPTIONS.md).

Thank you!
```
